body:
Follow-up 4 to the peer-prediction verification markets research package.

- New `whitewash` adversary: lies only when its signal says "faulty". PTS stays incentive-compatible, but averaged-PTS trust barely notices (trust ~0.92).
- New `stealth.py`: minority-label PTS trust (scored vs peers reporting "faulty", centred at half the median) plus LMSR liquidity scaling by trust mass. Brier 0.0046 -> 0.0023 (lie prob 0.5), 0.0205 -> 0.0025 (lie prob 1.0); all-honest unchanged. Fixed-b down-weighting alone made Brier worse (0.0107).
- 57 tests pass; README documents results and caveats.
